basic_info.description: In a hidden corner of SOMA, down a tiny alley off Hallam, there's a secret sanctuary waiting at 10 Brush Place. Step inside to find a cozy retreat where your bedroom opens to a serene garden, embraced by the shade of a mature Japanese maple. Imagine mornings by the fireplace, light streaming through skylights onto hardwood floors. Upstairs, a loft whispers of endless possibilitiesa quiet workspace or a dreamy hideaway. Deeded parking and all the charm of a small single-family alternative with incredibly low dues make this townhome a perfect urban escape.    Step outside, and you're just moments away from the vibrant heart of SOMA. Savor a morning latte at Sightglass Coffee, grab brunch at the lively Plow, or indulge in dinner at the trendy Marlowe. Explore unique boutiques and soak in the neighborhood's energy all within a stone's throw.  For the first time on the market in 25 years you will find off-street deeded parking, two bedrooms, and a full bath on the garden level with a lofted flex space above your living room.   Exceptionally low $175.00 monthly homeowners dues make this a home you can call your own for decades to come
